name: WA-09
label: Safe D

key_factors: Long-serving incumbent Adam Smith with large fundraising edge
Challenger Doug Basler raised only ~$12k with minimal cash
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: The district's D+22 lean, Smith's incumbency and roughly 150-to-1 fundraising advantage over Basler, and markets pricing a Democratic win near 97% all point the same way, with no polls or ratings suggesting otherwise.
model.watch: A surprise would require a major late scandal or external spending surge, neither of which is currently visible.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Adam Smith, a longtime Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored in a Seattle-area district that leans Democratic by about 22 points. He has raised nearly $1.9 million and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Doug Basler has raised only about $12,000 and has no meaningful outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put Smith's chances near 97 percent.

The fundamentals leave little room for doubt: the partisan lean, incumbency, and money gap all favor Smith by wide margins. Barring an unexpected external shock, this seat is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands.
